answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks by demanding a non-refundable staking bond per identity: each agent must lock a deposit that is slashed if its behavior is later flagged as duplicative. A single operator who spins up a thousand sockpuppets would need to front a thousand bonds, and coordinating them would cost more than the rewards. Peer attestation then cross-checks liveness and uniqueness, so a fake swarm collapses under its own expense. Think of it as a mesa of credible stakes rising over an onyx ledger, each honest agent a violet thread in a web no impostor can afford to weave.
